name: Blueprint Intake → SpecKit OpenCode Project Builder [EXECUTION GATE FIXED]

parameters.command: echo '=== HOST ===' && hostname && echo '=== OPENCODE ===' && opencode --version 2>&1 && echo '=== UV ===' && uv --version 2>&1 && echo '=== PYTHON ===' && python3 --version 2>&1 && echo '=== PROVIDER_ENV ===' && test -f /opt/dev-fabric/secrets/opencode-provider.env && echo 'EXISTS' || echo 'MISSING' && echo '=== PREFlight_COMPLETE ==='

={{`cd ${$json.project_dir} && echo '# ${$json.project_slug}

Created: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
Pipeline: Issue #19

## Status
- Spec Kit: pending
- Git: pending

## Blueprint
${$json.blueprint_content.slice(0, 500)}' > README.md && echo '${$json.blueprint_content}' > docs/blueprint/BLUEPRINT.raw.md && echo 'FILES_CREATED'`}}

={{`cd ${$json.project_dir} && uv tool install specify-cli --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v0.11.4 2>&1 && echo 'SPECIFY_INSTALLED' && specify --version && specify init . --integration opencode --force --ignore-agent-tools 2>&1 && echo 'SPECKIT_INIT_DONE'`}}
={{`cd ${$json.project_dir} && git init && git add -A && git commit -m 'feat: initialize project from blueprint' 2>&1 && echo 'GIT_INIT_DONE'`}}

={{`cd ${$json.project_dir} && source /opt/dev-fabric/secrets/opencode-provider.env && opencode --version && echo 'OPENCODE_READY' && echo 'Run Speckit phases manually:
1. /speckit.constitution
2. /speckit.specify
3. /speckit.clarify
4. /speckit.plan
5. /speckit.tasks
6. /speckit.analyze
7. /speckit.implement' > evidence/next-steps.md && echo 'OPENCODE_PHASE_READY'`}}
